sources.solve.py: Full-MPS native SCIP solve, fixed method setting, single-thread/time controls, real event capture, final complete vector and timing
sources.modelio.py: Original MPS sparse reader, raw ZIP reader, direct numeric vector validation and complete six-slot operating export
sources.validate.py: Saved-file checking implementation: original rows/domains/objective plus all wire-table and route/ledger reconciliation
sources.experiments.py: Six-run paired sequential default/feasibility study and source-provenance capture; skip recorded runs
sources.analyze.py: Saved-file audits, study-results JSON/CSV, eight rendered figures from actual experiments
sources.summarize.py: Port/class mechanism summaries and exact native parameter differences
sources.checks.py: Six deliberate corruption rejection tests, no optimization
sources.package.py: Final source-only archive, native/parsed model parity and final manifest/provenance checks

static_outputs.REPORT.md: Scientific account, comparisons, operating implications, uncertainty, limitations and attribution
static_outputs.HANDOFF.md: Exact native commands, layout and dependencies
static_outputs.study-design.json: Two methods, three inputs, identical numerical allocations and chronology
static_outputs.study-results.json: Unrounded outcomes and cost terms; study-results.csv is a tabular counterpart
static_outputs.operating-summary.json: All port-wise alpha, service quantities/calls and inventory summaries
static_outputs.class-route-summary.csv: Loaded voyages/quantity/cost by original class and destination
static_outputs.method-parameter-diff.json: Every observed native parameter setting changed by emphasis
static_outputs.validation-tests/results.json: Negative-test outcomes; accompanying copies are deliberately INVALID, never solver inputs
static_outputs.experiments/<instance>/<method>: Complete original vectors, operating tables, native result, event JSONL, original solver log, parameter set, validation and audit for each actual run

figure_inputs.figures/convergence.png: All six incumbents.jsonl files and terminal native-result.json records
figure_inputs.figures/economics.png: All six costs.csv files reconciled in operating-audit.json

exposure: Only supplied public problem/contract files and declared runtime, plus generic pip plotting dependencies. No external instance answers or other run roots. General model pretraining knowledge used; no pristine-pretraining claim.
